newsitem.title: USA: Parker & Parsley sets $270 mln 1997 budget.
newsitem.headline: Parker & Parsley sets $270 mln 1997 budget.

text.p: Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co said Thursday its board approved a capital budget of $270 million for 1997, a 35 percent increase over the 1996 budget.
The company said it expects the capital expenditure budget will be funded through internally generated cash flow.

Parker & Parsley said it will spend about $170 million or 63 percent of its capital budget on exploitation activities, and about 70 percent of those activities will be focused on drilling a total of 427 developmental wells in the Permian Basin of West Texas.
The company also expects it will spend about $67 million or 25 percent on exploration activities, which will include joint ventures as entrance vehicles in new core areas.
About $33 million or 12 percent will be spent on the acquisition of oil and gas properties in its core areas of Texas, Oklahoma, New Mexico and Louisiana.
